implemented_patches: Daily bonus without video (client path, experimental)
Custom group cover controls (client only, experimental)
input_constraint: Uploaded base declares splits.required=true and contains no native libraries. Matching split APKs are required for installation testing.
pull_reload_scope: English Conversation list only, recognized by visible heading plus room-list section; disabled in chat rooms and unknown screens. React runtime reload, not a data-only refresh.
user_report: Earlier SimSimi features were reported working. New six-feature selectors and updated listener were not device-tested.
daily_bonus_scope: Opt-in: existing membership non-video loader, with original server state, reward requests and errors retained. No fabricated ad completion or guaranteed credits.

six_feature_scope.defaults: All six selectors are opt-in and depend on Unlock membership UI.
six_feature_scope.conversation_level: Existing member level branch; actual server save and topics are unverified.
six_feature_scope.profile_photo: Existing picker path; upload and persistence are unverified.
six_feature_scope.group_cover: Existing picker plus client-side hasMembership flag in group data; no ownership or upload rights granted.
six_feature_scope.photo_send: Existing member send paths for direct and group chat, potentially skipping local quota/ad checks; delivery and server enforcement remain unverified.
six_feature_scope.read_receipts: Shows original msgHasBeenRead indicator only when data is available; does not create data or prove receipt accuracy.
six_feature_scope.items: Member UI only; no server entitlement, currency or stock is granted. Existing purchase actions can still cost coins.

quick_return_scope: Opt-in. Double-tapping the selected second bottom Chat tab on the English Conversation screen scrolls the largest visible vertical ScrollView to y=0. It does not reload. Layout and device behavior remain unverified.
